closed.reason: 261125-DEP-L2 removed the remaining provider-assets and search-provider-watcher wording from the runtime_install description in mcp/registration/core.py.

statement: The served description of runtime_install in mcp/registration/core.py names provider assets and the stop of leftover watchers of search providers; nothing else in the product sets up a search provider. The earlier provider-install/index/watcher guidance and the context_packet(include_providers=true) claim are gone from the public pages at the candidate.
